programmes.d: Joe goes looking for his missing father in the desert, then strange villagers take him captive; he finds his father and plans to escape, taking with him a woman that he has fallen for.
A woman writer (Karen Valentine) and a cavalry widow (Sandra Will) seek Billy the Kid.
An Indian girl (Kathryn Grant) and a land agent's daughter (Felicia Farr) save a part-Indian cattle rancher (Guy Madison) from vigilantes.
A practical-joking cowboy (Buck Jones) gets serious with outlaws.
A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.
A cavalry major (George Montgomery) makes peace with Indians despite an agitator (Richard Denning) working for carpetbaggers.
Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.
A U.S. marshal (James Philbrook) and his wife (Nancy Kovack) bring Union gold east through outlaws and Indians.
A rugged rancher (Van Heflin) with good and bad sons can only stop his bad son (Tab Hunter) with a gun.
Gold thieves and the government rile Geronimo, despite a cavalry captain's (George Montgomery) efforts at peace.

programmes.t: The Gun That Won the West
programmes.d: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.
A mustang stallion runs swiftly to the rescue when the boy who befriended him is endangered.
Framed for a murder he didn't commit, a cowboy hides with a traveling woman as he flees a sheriff and hunts for the real killer.
Flaming arrows stop four ex-convicts searching a ghost town for their buried loot.
A Texas Ranger (Guy Madison) turns deputy sheriff; a woman (Valerie French) wants him to kill her cattle-baron husband (Lorne Greene).
Lawyer Al (Dan Duryea) and brother Frank (Dick Foran) turn to robbing banks and trains after Union troops raid their home.
